# 2025–26 Kelantan The Real Warriors F.C. season

The 2025–26 season is the tenth season in the history of Kelantan The Real Warriors F.C., and the club's third consecutive season in Malaysia Super League. In addition to the domestic league, the team will participate in the Malaysia FA Cup and the Malaysia Cup.
